title: feat: Gallery/Timeline Spec Config 标准化接入 — nested config, strong types, full test coverage
body:
Standardizes Gallery and Timeline spec config integration across ObjectUI, replacing legacy flat prop spreading with nested config objects and strong types from `@objectstack/spec/ui`.

### Bug fix

In `ListView.tsx`, both gallery and timeline cases now pass config as nested objects instead of spreading flat:

```tsx
// Before (broken): cardSize/coverFit/visibleFields lost for gallery, timeline spread flat
return {
  type: 'object-gallery',
  ...baseProps,
  ...(schema.gallery || {}),  // spreads flat — ObjectGallery never sees schema.gallery
};

// After: both gallery and timeline pass nested config objects
return {
  type: 'object-gallery',
  ...baseProps,
  gallery: { ...(schema.options?.gallery || {}), ...(schema.gallery || {}) },
  imageField: schema.gallery?.coverField || ...,  // deprecated top-level fallback kept
};
```

### Strong types

- `ListViewSchema.gallery` and `.timeline` replaced from inline object types → `ListViewGalleryConfig` / `ListViewTimelineConfig` (intersection of spec canonical `GalleryConfig`/`TimelineConfig` + legacy fields + index signature for backward compat)
- New types exported from `@object-ui/types`
- Spec bridge `list-view.ts` updated from `any` → strong `ListViewGalleryConfig`/`ListViewTimelineConfig` types

### ObjectTimeline nested config support

- `ObjectTimeline` now accepts nested `schema.timeline.*` config (mirrors the `ObjectGallery` pattern)
- Fallback chain: `timeline.startDateField` → `mapping.date` → `startDateField` → `dateField` → `'date'`
- Maps `timeline.scale` → renderer `timeScale` property for gantt variant rendering
- Deprecated flat props retained for backward compatibility

### ObjectGallery

- Already reads from `schema.gallery.*` with legacy `imageField`/`titleField` fallbacks — no code changes needed

### Tests

- 12 ObjectGallery tests: `coverField`, `cardSize` grid class, `coverFit` object-contain, `visibleFields`, `titleField`, legacy fallbacks, spec-over-legacy priority
- 13 ObjectTimeline spec config tests: `startDateField`, `endDateField`, `groupByField`, `colorField`, `scale`, all scale enum values, backward compat fallbacks, spec-over-flat priority
- 10 type-level tests validating `ListViewSchema` accepts spec config, legacy fields, `options.*` fallback, cardSize/coverFit enums, and gallery+timeline co-existence
- 70 bridge tests pass (existing, validating gallery/timeline passthrough)

> - Timeline 支持 Spec `timeline` config：`startDateField`, `endDateField`, `titleField`, `groupByField`, `colorField`, `scale`

> - `packages/react/src/spec-bridge/bridges/list-view.ts` — bridge 已传递，需映射到实际 props

> - `packages/plugin-gallery/src/ObjectGallery.tsx` — 接受新的 prop 命名

> - [ ] Legacy `options.gallery` / `options.timeline` 仍向后兼容
> - [ ] 所有新增代码有对应单元测试
